instruction: Cinematic film still, medium shot. In a bright indoor hallway, the man in the brown cardigan (R1) kneels on the left, facing right. He raises his right hand to high-five the boy in the white school shirt (R2), who stands on the right wearing a grey backpack and a black tie. The boy raises his left hand to meet the man's hand in the center. Both maintain a calm, focused expression in profile against a closed white door. Soft, cool daylight from the side illuminates the scene, highlighting their interaction with a gentle, muted color palette.
